Bhopal Lawyers Protest After Advocate Assaulted at Police Station

Lawyers in Bhopal protested after an advocate was allegedly assaulted at the Jahangirabad police station. The incident led to enraged advocates surrounding the station. Following the protest and commotion, the Jahangirabad Station House Officer (TI) was suspended.
